item.title: How credible is Russia’s threat against UK? - The Latest
item.summary: Russia has threatened the UK with ‘consequences’ after reports that British drones were used by Ukraine to strike targets on Russia’s mainland for the first time. The Ministry of Defence has rebuffed these threats, saying the UK is ‘committed to providing equipment Ukraine needs to defend itself against Putin’s illegal invasion’. Annie Kelly speaks to senior international correspondent Luke Harding Luke’s new book Betrayal: Trump, Putin and the New Age of Conquest will be published next week Continue reading...
